import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebras

/-!
# Semilinear descent of modules over algebras

Let `L/K` be finite Galois and let `R` be a semilinear `L`-algebra. An
`R`-module with compatible semilinear action descends to a module over the fixed
algebra. This is the affine module producer for Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R]
  [IsScalarTower K L R] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R]
  [IsSemilinear K L R]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]

include R in
omit [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower K L R] [Module K M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] in
/-- Compatibility with the semilinear algebra action implies semilinearity
of the underlying vector space. -/
theorem isSemilinear_of_smulDistribClass : IsSemilinear K L M where
  smul_smul' g a m := by
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul R a m, smul_distrib_smul,
      smul_algebraMap, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

/-- The fixed vectors form a module over the fixed algebra. -/
def invariantModule : Submodule (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) M where
  carrier := {m | ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, g • m = m}
  zero_mem' g := smul_zero g
  add_mem' hx hy g := by rw [smul_add, hx, hy]
  smul_mem' r m hm g := by
    change g • ((r : R) • m) = (r : R) • m
    rw [smul_distrib_smul, r.2 g, hm g]

omit [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] in
@[simp]
theorem mem_invariantModule {m : M} :
    m ∈ invariantModule K L R M ↔ ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, g • m = m := Iff.rfl

/-- Restricting the fixed module to `K` recovers the invariant vector space. -/
def invariantModuleLinearEquiv [IsSemilinear K L M] :
    invariantModule K L R M ≃ₗ[K] invariants K L M where
  toFun m := ⟨m.1, m.2⟩
  invFun m := ⟨m.1, m.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- The scalar-extension comparison for the invariant module. -/
noncomputable def moduleDescentMap :
    R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[R] M :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R _ (invariantModule K L R M).subtype)

omit [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] in
@[simp]
theorem moduleDescentMap_tmul (r : R) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    moduleDescentMap K L R M (r ⊗ₜ m) = r • (m : M) := rfl

/-- The tensor map induced by the coefficient inclusion `L → R`. -/
noncomputable def fieldToModuleTensor :
    L ⊗[K] invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[L]
      R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton L _
      ((TensorProduct.mk (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) R
        (invariantModule K L R M) 1).restrictScalars K))

omit [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M] in
@[simp]
theorem fieldToModuleTensor_tmul (a : L) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    fieldToModuleTensor K L R M (a ⊗ₜ[K] m) = algebraMap L R a ⊗ₜ m := by
  simp [fieldToModuleTensor, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', Algebra.smul_def]

/-- The algebra-module comparison factors the vector-space comparison. -/
theorem moduleDescentMap_fieldToModuleTensor [IsSemilinear K L M]
    (x : L ⊗[K] invariantModule K L R M) :
    moduleDescentMap K L R M (fieldToModuleTensor K L R M x) =
      descentMap K L M
        (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl K L)
          (invariantModuleLinearEquiv K L R M) x) := by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a m =>
      simp only [fieldToModuleTensor_tmul, moduleDescentMap_tmul,
        TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, descentMap_tmul]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul R a (m : M)
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

omit [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M] in
/-- Expanding coefficients by algebra descent proves surjectivity of the
tensor map from field scalar extension. -/
theorem fieldToModuleTensor_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (fieldToModuleTensor K L R M) := by
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | tmul r m =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (descentAlgEquiv K L R).surjective r
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      | tmul a s =>
          refine ⟨a ⊗ₜ[K] (s • m), ?_⟩
          rw [fieldToModuleTensor_tmul, descentAlgEquiv_tmul,
            ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
          congr 1
          change (s : R) * algebraMap L R a = a • (s : R)
          rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
      | add y z hy hz =>
          obtain ⟨ty, hty⟩ := hy
          obtain ⟨tz, htz⟩ := hz
          exact ⟨ty + tz, by rw [map_add, hty, htz, map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul]⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨tx, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨ty, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨tx + ty, map_add _ _ _⟩

/-- The canonical comparison is bijective, by Speiser descent for the
underlying vector space and algebra. -/
theorem moduleDescentMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (moduleDescentMap K L R M) := by
  letI := isSemilinear_of_smulDistribClass K L R M
  let e := TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl K L)
    (invariantModuleLinearEquiv K L R M)
  have hcomp : Function.Bijective
      ((moduleDescentMap K L R M) ∘ (fieldToModuleTensor K L R M)) := by
    have h : (moduleDescentMap K L R M) ∘ (fieldToModuleTensor K L R M) =
        (descentMap K L M) ∘ e :=
      funext (moduleDescentMap_fieldToModuleTensor K L R M)
    rw [h]
    exact (descentMap_bijective K L M).comp e.bijective
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := fieldToModuleTensor_surjective K L R M x
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := fieldToModuleTensor_surjective K L R M y
    exact congrArg (fieldToModuleTensor K L R M) (hcomp.1 h)
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hcomp.2 m
    exact ⟨fieldToModuleTensor K L R M x, hx⟩

/-- A compatible semilinear module is the scalar extension of its fixed
module over the fixed algebra. -/
noncomputable def moduleDescentEquiv :
    R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M ≃ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (moduleDescentMap K L R M)
    (moduleDescentMap_bijective K L R M)

@[simp]
theorem moduleDescentEquiv_tmul (r : R) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    moduleDescentEquiv K L R M (r ⊗ₜ m) = r • (m : M) := rfl

/-- The inclusion of the fixed algebra is faithfully flat: it is, up to the
algebra descent comparison, the base change of the field extension `K → L`. -/
theorem faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints :
    Module.FaithfullyFlat (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) R := by
  let A := FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  let f : A ⊗[K] L →ₐ[A] R :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv K A L R (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L R)
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    have h : ⇑f = ⇑(descentAlgEquiv K L R) ∘ ⇑(TensorProduct.comm K A L) := by
      funext x
      induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | tmul s a =>
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
          change (s : R) * algebraMap L R a = a • (s : R)
          rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
      | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [h]
    exact (descentAlgEquiv K L R).bijective.comp (TensorProduct.comm K A L).bijective
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv A (A ⊗[K] L)
    (AlgEquiv.ofBijective f hf).symm.toLinearEquiv

/-- A finitely generated semilinear module descends to a finitely generated
module over the fixed algebra. -/
theorem finite_invariantModule [Module.Finite R M] :
    Module.Finite (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) (invariantModule K L R M) := by
  letI := faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints K L R
  letI : Module.Finite R
      (R ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M).symm
  exact Module.Finite.of_finite_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat R

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
